evidence: Equivalence of the selection change: 'any(start < index for start in starts)' equals 'starts is non-empty and starts[0] < index' because the start list is ascending. Probe review-a-3 compared the 0b6670d module with the 33f608d module on all 21845 logs of length 0 to 7 over a 4-token alphabet and on 3000 random logs of length 0 to 79 over 12 line kinds: 0 differences.

The contracts.md end rule 'the block ends at the last END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line that has a MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line above it' matches the code: an end line at index i has a start above it exactly when starts[0] < i. Probe: a log 'END / dispositions: F1=bad / START / role: x / END' gives no feedback, because the first end line has no start above it.

The contracts.md start rule matches the code. 'The last start line of the block' is starts_before_end[-1]; the last end line before it is floor; the block starts at the first start line after floor, which equals block_starts[0]. Probes: a start line on line 1 starts the block; 'START / role: x / END / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / END' gives feedback (the Review B case); an invalid line above the block start does not count; a second start line inside the block cannot hide a line above it.

The docstring states the same two rules (with 'It' for the block) and the linear-cost sentence. The code scans the line list a fixed number of times: starts, ends, the end loop, starts_before_end, earlier_ends, block_starts, and the block range. Probe: 20003 lines with 20000 end lines run in 0.007 s, against 15.351 s for the old code on 40003 lines per the Review B measurement.

The plan line 'Review remediation F1-F3 (Review B nonblocking items 1, 4, 5): 478b723; linear block selection, exact range text, 213407f note corrected' is true. Review B nonblocking items 1, 4, and 5 at 0b6670d are the quadratic selection, the contracts.md:119 range text, and the 213407f note claim. Commit 478b723 holds the first two fixes. The 213407f note now ends with 'Correction (S3 round 4): a dispositions: line after the last END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line does not count, so that Red case exits 0, as test_checker.py checks', which matches test_checker.py test_edge_line_after_end_marker_is_ignored and the probe behavior.

The 478b723 commit note claims hold: the equivalence claim (probe: 0 differences), the linear timing claim (probe: 0.007 s), and the claim that the doc test words stay unchanged (grep: the doc test never asserted the changed sentences; run.sh passes).

Anti-pattern checks: no count assertion changed in this diff (A3 not applicable); the dispositions check rejects every malformed fixture that probe 1 and probe 3 built, so no vacuous pass (A4); every plan and note claim that this diff added was verified against live runs (A5).
